{{Quote|Smothered in black ash up to 300 meters deep, Aplooine possesses only a scattering of stable landing points atop weathered mountains. It lacks a breathable atmosphere but has harbored colonists since the Kymoodon Era due to its position on the Duros Space Run.|A cartographical survey and field report by Vannar Treece|<ref name="Gazetteer" />}}
'''Aplooine''' was an ash-covered [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. Its surface only featured a limited number of stable landing points on [[Mountain/Legends|mountaintops]]; nevertheless, the world served as one of the origin points of the spread of [[Scout/Legends|exploration]] of surrounding [[Realspace/Legends|space]] during the [[Kymoodon Era]]. During the [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] following that [[Time/Legends|time]], Aplooine continued to harbor [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]].

==Description==
Aplooine was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Gazetteer" /> located in the [[Aplooine system/Legends|Aplooine system]], a part of the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="TrailingSectors" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Duros Space Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], which linked it to the [[Sanrafsix system/Legends|Sanrafsix]] and [[Verdanth system/Legends|Verdanth systems]]. Aplooine's surface was covered in a layer of [[Color/Legends|black]] ash that was up to three hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]] deep, with weathered [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] harboring the only scattering of stable landing points. The world's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was not breathable.<ref name="Gazetteer" />

==History==
{{Quote|But a few centuries after settlement began to spread from worlds such as Aplooine and Heptooine, the faith of Mani was split by a schism that soon proved irreparable.|A cartographical survey and field report by Vannar Treece|<ref name="Gazetteer" />}}
[[File:ProtoGrumaniSectorPiusDeaEra-EGTW.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A small pocket of explored space grew around Aplooine and Heptooine during the Kymoodon Era.]]
Aplooine and [[Heptooine]] were two worlds<ref name="Gazetteer" /> around which a small pocket of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&ndash;[[Scout/Legends|explored]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the southern quadrant of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] spread during the [[Kymoodon Era]] of [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]&ndash;[[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Due to its position on the Duros Space Run, Aplooine continued to serve as a [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] for [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] following that [[Time/Legends|time]] period.<ref name="Gazetteer" /> By the time between approximately 12,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and [[11,000 BBY]], the world had become a part of the Republic despite being situated in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EGTW" /> In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]],<ref name="1032 BBY">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}} is presented as an [[in-universe]] [[Astrography|cartographical]] survey and field report compiled shortly before the [[Raid on Oranessan|commencement]] of [[Operation Influx]], which {{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_influx/index.html|text=''Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx''|int=Star Wars: Knight Errant: Influx}} dates to [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vannar Treece]] briefly mentioned Aplooine in a [[Astrography|cartographical]] survey and field report on the Grumani [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Gazetteer" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aplooine was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]. The book placed it in grid square M-17;<ref name="TEA" /> however, [[The Knight Errant Gazetteer|''Essential Atlas'' Extra: The ''Knight Errant'' Gazetteer]], a [[2010]] [[StarWars.com]] article co-authored by Wallace, Fry, and [[John Jackson Miller]], instead placed it in<ref name="GazetteerOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/knighterrant_atlas/index.html|text=''Essential Atlas'' Extra: The ''Knight Errant'' Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref> what ''The Essential Atlas'' designated as grid square N-17;<ref name="TEA" /> a placement that was later confirmed by the StarWars.com [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book.<ref name="EAOC" />
